summary.text: Amy Kippenbrock is the Republican candidate for Indiana House of Representatives District 63 in the November 3, 2026 general election. She says she has served as Dubois County Clerk for the past eight years.

paragraphs.text: Amy Kippenbrock graduated from Jasper High School, and Ballotpedia lists her profession as business management.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she has family roots in Martin County, grew up in and lives in Dubois County, and has raised her family there with her husband.
She said that as Dubois County Clerk she has managed a public office, administered elections and worked within a budget.
Kippenbrock advanced from the Republican primary on May 5, 2026.

She listed election integrity, affordability and tax policy, economic development, infrastructure and rural representation as priorities, and named elections, veterans, the Department of Defense, the Department of Natural Resources and small businesses as policy interests.
